scope: On-demand physical parameter-buffer backing in the shared T6030/T6031 G15 driver. Normal M1/M2 GPU, board admission, display, DTs, UAPI, Mesa and m1n1 are unchanged.

allocator.committed_backing_lifetime: Retained at its peak until reboot; no shrinking.

review_fixes: Allocate and DMA-map exact aligned backing with checked segment ends and complete SG coverage.
Catch every VM up before publishing work; validate one executing VM and retain aliases before advancing per-VM progress.
Prepare backing before accepting growth requests, publishing block records, the producer or a success reply.
Keep failure tests bounded; require the intended test and message for standalone mutations as well as the full gate.

native_build.method: Full targets from a clean checkout at the frozen production commit, using a separate reflinked output directory and BINDGEN_LAYOUT_TESTS=1 from the first make.

control_tooling_checks.shellcheck: 0.11.0, official static build verified against release asset digest

limits: No target install, reboot, signed artifact, catalog or public installer change is part of this source integration.
Host tests mock GEM, SG and MMU services; they do not execute kernel mappings or GPU firmware.
Closed-but-inflight VM compatibility rests on the actual job-guard and VM-cleanup source audit, not on a closed-VM model test.
The reuse test resets the ledger; it is not a complete firmware recovery test. Post-accept store and reply errors keep the prior ledger behavior.
Backing is grow-only and retained at its peak. Synchronous allocation/reclaim latency while the GPU waits is not bounded or hardware-qualified.
Growth beyond initial backing, multiple clients, memory pressure, recovery, suspend and power require hardware qualification before a release.
Hard-limit refusal/deadline behavior is preserved; successful recovery is not guaranteed.
Two private-fixture tests remain ignored; no private board data or raw machine logs are published.
